AFTER.text:
AFTER(G)>NAME := f2(x0)    [reproduces 78/78 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f2(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))

BEFORE.text:
BEFORE(G)>NAME := nthN(order, sub(f4(x0), 1))    [reproduces 78/78 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f4(#0:G) -> Z := index_of(order, f0(#0))

BETWEEN.text:
BETWEEN(G,G)>NAME := f2(x0)    [reproduces 72/72 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f2(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))

CHAIN.text:
AFTER then OTHER_CASE := compose of the parts' programs, in order (a NAME passed on to a glyph slot is the name's first TEACH exemplar)
  AFTER(G)>NAME := f2(x0)
  OTHER_CASE(G;cands)>PICK := nthG(cands, f4(x0))
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f2(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))
  where f4(#0:G) -> Z := index_of(order, f0(#0))

LOOP.text:
LOOP(G)>YESNO := f3(x0, nthN(order, 1))    [reproduces 192/228 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f1(#0:G) -> B := eq(f0(#0), nthN(order, 0))
  where f3(#0:G, #1:N) -> B := or(f1(#0), @IS(N,G)>YESNO(#1, #0))
  where @IS(N,G)>YESNO := eq(f0(x1), x0)

MIRROR.text:
MIRROR(G)>YESNO := compose(&AFTER(G)>NAME, compose(&TWO_AFTER(G)>NAME, compose(&TWO_AFTER(G)>NAME, &LOOP(G)>YESNO)))    [reproduces 181/216 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f1(#0:G) -> B := eq(f0(#0), nthN(order, 0))
  where f2(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))
  where f3(#0:G, #1:N) -> B := or(f1(#0), @IS(N,G)>YESNO(#1, #0))
  where @LOOP(G)>YESNO := f3(x0, nthN(order, 1))
  where @IS(N,G)>YESNO := eq(f0(x1), x0)
  where @AFTER(G)>NAME := f2(x0)
  where @TWO_AFTER(G)>NAME := compose(&AFTER(G)>NAME, &AFTER(G)>NAME)

OTHER_CASE.text:
OTHER_CASE(G;cands)>PICK := nthG(cands, f4(x0))    [reproduces 36/36 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f4(#0:G) -> Z := index_of(order, f0(#0))

TWO_AFTER.text:
TWO_AFTER(G)>NAME := compose(&AFTER(G)>NAME, &AFTER(G)>NAME)    [reproduces 36/36 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f2(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))
  where @AFTER(G)>NAME := f2(x0)

VOWEL.text:
VOWEL(G)>YESNO := f1(x0)    [reproduces 264/312 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f1(#0:G) -> B := eq(f0(#0), nthN(order, 0))
